20 Insanely Cute Sweater Nails for Fall and Winter

  • Elisa
  • November 3, 2026
SAVE IT
By ElisaFounder & Editor6 min read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:45
Instaread
When you purchase through our links, we may earn an affiliate commission at no extra cost to you.

Can we talk about how cute nail designs get during fall and winter? I love the little snowflakes and all the gorgeous darker colors. But the sweater patterns might be my favorite. There is just something about those tiny braided designs that makes me want to plan my next manicure right now, lol!

The fun thing about sweater nails is that you can keep it simple with one patterned nail or go all out on every finger. Add a little glitter for the holidays or stick to a soft neutral shade. You don't need to include every design you love on one hand, though I know it is tempting!

If you need some inspo before your next nail appointment, you're definitely in the right place. Below you'll find 20 gorgeous ideas with raised sweater patterns, cute holiday details and a few smooth designs for when you want to switch things up. There are plenty of options here to get you excited for the season!

Sweater Nails to Try This Season

soft blurred stripes

Shop it on Amazonrom&nd Blur Fudge Tint→

How cool are these blurry stripes? I love the soft gray and brown together. This one skips the raised sweater pattern but still gives you a pretty option for the season.

Ask for faded bands over a sheer pink base and keep the finish glossy. Go with an almond shape to recreate the look.

dark nails and cream cables

Shop it on Amazon48Pcs Dark Coffee Press on Nails Almond Faux Nails→

I am loving how dark these nails are! The cream sweater accents really stand out against that deep burgundy shade.

Keep a few nails solid and ask for a raised cable design on the cream ones. Add a plaid accent with thin black and burgundy lines if you want a little more detail.

brown dots and stripes

Shop it on AmazonBig Dots Hair Foils For Highlighting→

Who knew brown polka dots could look this adorable? The striped tips are another favorite of mine here.

Use chocolate brown and cream for the patterns. Mix dotted nails with striped French tips instead of giving every nail the same design.

little hearts and glitter

Shop it on AmazonNature Friends Lift-a-Flap Boxed Set 4-Pack: Little Barn→

OMG, those tiny raised hearts are insanely cute. I would have such a hard time not staring at them all day, haha!

Choose a pale pink base and add hearts down the center of your sweater accent nails. Include a glitter nail and glitter French tips if you want that extra sparkle.

gold bows and snowflakes

Shop it on AmazonPcs Gift Bows Assortment→

The little gold bows have me obsessed with this set. They look like tiny gift ribbons on your nails!

Ask for full cream cable-patterned nails and separate gold-edged white French tips. Add a white snowflake over the pink base and save a nail for plaid if you want to recreate all the details.

berry red holiday nails

Shop it on AmazonChristmas Press On Nails Short Oval Faux Nails Nails→

This berry shade is so gorgeous for the holidays. And that little reindeer face? Way too cute!

Start with a matte berry base and use white for the snowflakes and holiday patterns. Keep the geometric accents pink and add a few rhinestones along the cuticles for some sparkle.

green french tips

Shop it on AmazonPcs French Fries Holder→

I think this green might be one of my favorite colors on the list. It is so pretty without needing any glitter or holiday designs.

Alternate green French tips with matte green sweater nails. Keep the base of the French tips a soft pink so the green really pops.

burgundy and cream plaid

Shop it on Amazon'Oreal Paris Makeup Voluminous Original Mascara→

Burgundy is such a gorgeous choice for fall. I especially love how the cream cable nail breaks up all that dark color.

Choose a glossy burgundy for the solid nails and cream for the patterned ones. Use a fine nail brush for the black plaid lines and include a couple of burgundy stripes.

tiny gingerbread man

Shop it on Amazon24Pcs Marble Almond Press on Nails Faux Nails False→

How adorable is that little gingerbread man?! This is such a cute way to do Christmas nails without using bright red and green.

Stick to a pale neutral base and light cable designs. Add a gingerbread accent with tiny white details and a delicate snowflake on another nail.

pink raised hearts

Shop it on AmazonValentine's Wooden Heart Ornaments→

For my girlies who love pink, you need to see this one. Those raised hearts would be super cute for Valentine's Day too.

Pick a few pink and peach shades instead of using just one color. Ask for a mix of filled hearts and heart outlines in matching shades.

gingham and little bows

Shop it on AmazonLinen Sets for Women 2 Piece Two Piece Tank→

I love a short nail set with lots of little details. The white bow on the French tip is definitely my favorite part here.

Keep the shape short and square with soft pink bases on the French tip nails. Mix brown gingham accents with dotted French tips and a cream polka-dot nail.

baby blue and silver

Shop it on AmazonChristmas Tree Topper Glitter Christmas Bows 12" Wide Snowflake→

This baby blue is absolutely gorgeous! If you want a winter manicure that isn't red or white, this is a must-try.

Ask for raised blue cable patterns and a silver glitter accent on each hand. Add gray and white plaid lines to the pinkies for another cute detail.

chocolate plaid nails

Shop it on Amazon24Pcs Fall Press on Nails Short Square Faux Nails→

I am such a fan of this chocolate brown. You don't always need a different design on every finger to make your nails look good.

Paint each nail dark brown and add thin pale lines going across and down. Keep the pattern flat if you prefer something without the raised sweater details.

red and white reindeer

Shop it on AmazonExasinine 3 Pcs Reindeer Christmas Decor Resin Reindeer Figurines→

Now this is a set for someone who wants to go all out for Christmas! The white reindeer is so cute against the red.

Combine cream sweater accents with red holiday nails. Ask for white snowflakes, little dots and reindeer designs on the red ones to get this festive look.

pumpkins and copper shimmer

Shop it on AmazonOgrmar 12 Pack Artificial Assorted Pumpkins→

The little white pumpkins are making me love this set even more. I especially like the shiny outlines instead of the usual orange pumpkin design.

Choose copper-red shimmer for a couple of nails and include a white cable accent. Add a pumpkin over a nude base and use the same shimmery red for the plaid stripes.

wreaths and red bows

Shop it on AmazonChristmas Nail Stickers Christmas Sock Nail Art Stickers→

Who else loves a tiny wreath design? These are so festive even without a single raised cable pattern.

Use a pale base for the green wreaths and red bows. Add red polka-dot nails and little red and white dots around the edges of the remaining nails.

mauve cable nails

Shop it on AmazonGlamnetic Fall Press On Nails→

These are the kind of sweater nails that make me want every single finger covered in patterns. I love the deep plum and lighter pink shades together.

Ask for long squared tips and a matte finish. Use a few shades from dark plum to pale pink and repeat the raised cable design all the way down.

lavender sweater patterns

Shop it on AmazonScrapbook Paper: Heart Patterns→

This lavender shade is so pretty! I like that every nail has its own little pattern without bringing in a bunch of different colors.

Use the same muted purple across the whole set. Mix raised dots, loops and diamond shapes to give each nail something different.

black nails and snowflakes

Shop it on AmazonChrome Press on Nails Almond Nails Press ons Metallic→

If you love dark nails, this one deserves a spot on your inspo list. The white snowflakes stand out so much against the black.

Combine a black French tip with a full black snowflake nail. Add a textured black cable accent and keep the tips square to recreate this set.

white cables and gold glitter

Shop it on AmazonSwitch HDMI 2 Port Box→

I couldn't leave out this gorgeous white and gold set. That thin gold line under the French tip is such a pretty little detail!

Ask for white cable patterns on two nails and a sweater French tip on another. Finish with gold glitter accents if you want a holiday manicure that will definitely garner compliments.
